deploy_role: Frozen scripts for already-owned campaign. Local controllers resolve evidence root from their deployed file directory; deploy there, do not run from this archive.
opponent_policy: GPU-only shards; candidate arrivals preempt between races; default tail waits completed builds and no fresh claims; exact hardware/runtime provenance; no old RTX4090 timings reused
measurement_policy: Existing identity accepted. Missing timing entrypoints only are built. Driver warmup+score runs once.
effective_shape_dedup: binary hash, candidate id, arm, source-derived effective environment; never rewrite old tasks
runtime_notes: Remote worker PIDs are historical; current repair-launch/status receipts in evidence are authoritative. CUDA13 implicit uses isolated per-arm environment and targeted ALS retry, no CPU fallback.
